t: The Spectrum Water Hardness Test Pack provides a straightforward method for assessing water hardness levels. This is essential for plumbers and heating engineers installing or maintaining water softeners in residential and commercial properties. The easy-to-use strips deliver fast, accurate indications of hardness, allowing for effective setup and monitoring of water treatment systems. It is suitable for checking both untreated and softened water, ensuring optimal performance. Supplied as a convenient 5-pack, it supports routine testing and maintenance tasks.
